newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: VNU BUSINESS INFO PROFITS OFFSET TV LOSSES.
newsitem.headline: VNU BUSINESS INFO PROFITS OFFSET TV LOSSES.

text.p: VNU, reporting interim profits at the high end of market expectations, said on Tuesday growth in profits from business information had offset losses on its Dutch and Belgian commercial TV interests.
"With the exception of commercial broadcasting, all groups contributed to the improvement in operating income," the Dutch publisher said in a statement.
"Most significant was growth at business information in the United States and Europe," it added.
VNU said increased competition in the field of commercial television had put pressure on advertising rates, resulting in a first-half loss on the group's TV interests.

VNU has recently pooled its 38 percent stake in the Dutch channels RTL4 and RTL5 in Holland Media Group (HMG) which also includes the fledgling Dutch channel Veronica. In Belgium it has a 44 percent stake in the Flemish channel VTM.
VNU said RTL4 and VTM remained the leading channels in their respective markets, adding that it planned far-reaching measures which would lead to improved TV results from 1997.

In the Netherlands VNU's RTL4 and RTL5 have had to fight off the challenge of new general interest channel SBS6 and the recently launched specialised channel Sport7 which secured TV rights to all of this season's Dutch league soccer matches.
VNU said its other businesses -- consumer magazines, newspapers and educational publishing -- had all made satisfactory progress in the first half of 1996.
